description: This file defines a class for validating the CSS 'text-decoration' property values within the HTMLPurifier library. It ensures that only allowed decoration styles ('line-through', 'overline', 'underline') are accepted and processes input strings accordingly.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_CSS_TextDecoration
classes.description: A class responsible for validating the CSS 'text-decoration' property values.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the input string for the 'text-decoration' property, allowing only specific styles or 'none'.
